title: Coupler
text: 使用 S 参数对理想的频率无关耦合器进行建模；按 {Reference impedances (Ohm)} 指定耦合器的参考阻抗；{Select component} 指定耦合器类型 Directional、{Coupling (dB)} 指定耦合到输出端口的输入信号功率占比、{Directivity (dB)} 指定耦合端口功率与隔离端口功率之比、{Insertion loss (dB)} 指定输入端口和输出端口之间的信号功率损耗、{Return loss (dB)} 指定因阻抗失配造成的信号功率损耗、{Power transmission coefficient} 指定传输信号功率、{Ground and hide negative terminals} 指定 RF 电路端子接地，按实例取值。

params.name: Select component
params.values: 耦合器类型 Directional coupler (default) | Coupler symmetrical | Coupler antisymmetrical | Hybrid quadrature (90 deg) | Hybrid rat-race | Magic tee

params.name: Coupling (dB)
params.values: 耦合到输出端口的输入信号功率占比 0 (default) | nonnegative and real scalar

params.name: Directivity (dB)
params.values: 耦合端口功率与隔离端口功率之比 inf (default) | nonnegative and real scalar

params.name: Insertion loss (dB)
params.values: 输入端口和输出端口之间的信号功率损耗 inf (default) | nonnegative and real scalar

params.name: Return loss (dB)
params.values: 因阻抗失配造成的信号功率损耗 inf (default) | nonnegative and real scalar

params.name: Power transmission coefficient
params.values: 传输信号功率 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Reference impedances (Ohm)
params.values: 耦合器的参考阻抗 50 (default) | positive scalar | positive three-tuple vector

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: RF 电路端子接地 on (default) | off
